name: Dirt Candy
dinnerNote: Five-course tasting menu (tip included, tax extra)

menus.name: Five-course vegetable tasting menu
menus.note: The only menu, changed with the seasons. Prices include the tip but not tax; non-alcoholic pairing $45.

bookingOpens: Online on Resy, or by phone. Reservations are not taken by email, and a credit card is needed to book.
cancellation: Cancel at least 24 hours ahead, or a fee of $50 per person is charged. Changes to a booking are made by phone.
walkIns: Walk-ins are welcome: tables often open up on the night for anyone willing to be flexible.
waitlist: Choose "Notify" on Resy for the time wanted, and Resy alerts you as soon as a table opens.
